api_keys_name_check.name: api_keys_name_check
api_keys_name_check.value: char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) >= 1 AND char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) <= 60

feedback_messages_content_check.name: feedback_messages_content_check
feedback_messages_content_check.value: char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM content)) >= 1 AND char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM content)) <= 2000

feedback_reports_author_unread_idx.name: feedback_reports_author_unread_idx
feedback_reports_author_unread_idx.where: ((last_admin_message_at IS NOT NULL) AND ((author_read_at IS NULL) OR (last_admin_message_at > author_read_at)))
